instruction: Complete the task using command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral PCB package `demo.ipc2581`, `nc_param.json`, and `components.json` are on the desktop. Generate NC drill output. Requirements: - Write `demo.drl`, `ncdrill.log`, and `collision_report.json`. - The drill file must use the requested 1-4 span and tool settings, and encode that span/plating with the XNC attribute `TF.FileFunction,Plated,1,4,PTH`. - Use all vias and their referenced padstack holes as drill hits/tools. - Treat board component x/y locations as points when checking circular keepouts. `collision_report.json` must contain `checked_components`, source-ordered `collisions` entries with `component` and `keepout`, and `status` equal to `clear` or `collision`. - The log must state the 1-4 span and actual tool count. [Software] Altium Designer is available at `D:\Altium\AD26\X2.EXE`. OrCAD Capture is available at `D:\orcad\tools\bin\Capture.exe`. OpenSCAD is available as `openscad`.
